title: Pikachu Confused
blurb: Pikachu's confused noise — the audio companion to the surprised Pikachu face, one of the most-used reaction images ever made. It's the sound of shock at an entirely predictable outcome: the consequences you were warned about arriving exactly on schedule. Play it when someone acts shocked by their own decisions.
origin: The confused vocalisation behind the Surprised Pikachu meme.
